en.headline: John Lee visits Wang Fuk Court residents in Aberdeen ahead of fire anniversary
en.dek: The Chief Executive met two households temporarily housed in Aberdeen, who said they expected to receive keys to new flats next month.
body: Chief Executive John Lee visited Wang Fuk Court residents temporarily housed in Aberdeen last Saturday, accompanied by Home and Youth Affairs Secretary Alice Mak and Labour and Welfare Secretary Chris Sun, the government said on Wednesday.

Lee met two households. The residents said they expected to collect keys to their new flats next month and that the units met their needs. They thanked the government, the one-household-one-social-worker scheme and care teams for assistance with subsidies, document replacement and medical arrangements.

Lee said the government shared the residents' sorrow over the fire and would continue full support, including accelerating long-term housing arrangements so affected families could start new lives as soon as possible. He also noted ongoing systemic reforms and anti-bid-rigging measures.

The Support Fund for Wang Fuk Court will continue rental subsidies to owners until the end of 2027. The third and fourth instalments of HK$75,000 each will be paid in December this year and June next year. Additional living support subsidies of HK$300,000 per owner household and HK$200,000 per deceased family are also planned.

zh.headline: 李家超探訪宏福苑火災受影響居民稱政府持續提供支援
zh.dek: 行政長官上周六到香港仔探訪暫居居民，兩戶居民表示預計下月收取新單位鎖匙。
body: 政府今日公布，行政長官李家超上周六在民政及青年事務局局長麥美娟和勞工及福利局局長孫玉菡陪同下，到香港仔探訪暫居該處的宏福苑火災受影響居民，了解他們的近況和新居安排進展。
李家超與兩戶居民交流。居民表示將遷入新單位，預計下月收樓，認為新單位切合需要，並感謝政府、「一戶一社工」及關愛隊在申請資助、補辦證件及安排醫護等方面的協助。
李家超表示，政府對於這場火災感同身受，深感難過，整個團隊會繼續全力支援居民，安排「一戶一社工」和關愛隊全面跟進需要，並加快長遠房屋配置，讓居民早日展開新生活。
「大埔宏福苑援助基金」向業主發放的租金補助將維持至2027年底，第三期及第四期每戶各7.5萬元分別於今年12月及明年6月發放。基金亦將推出向每戶業主發放30萬元及每名罹難者家屬發放20萬元的新生活支援補助。
